title: Statistical and Privacy Guarantees for Deep M-Regression via Stochastic Gradient Langevin Dynamics
abstract: arXiv:2611.07490v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In this article, we study deep nonparametric regression trained via stochastic gradient Langevin dynamics (SGLD), a variant of stochastic gradient descent that injects carefully calibrated Gaussian noise during optimization. Using a PAC-Bayesian analysis tailored to deep ReLU networks, we establish an excess-risk bound that simultaneously accounts for network approximation error, statistical complexity, and the algorithmic cost accumulated along the SGLD trajectory. Under a Bernstein condition and within a stable SGLD regime, the excess-risk bound contains a stochastic term whose coefficient is inversely proportional to the variance of injected noise, while the estimator retains the optimal rate for nonparametric regression under the H\"older smoothness condition up to logarithmic factors. This result provides an approximation-error-aware, rate-optimal statistical perspective on the widely observed generalization benefits of moderate S

translated_title: 通过随机梯度朗之万动力学实现深度M回归的统计与隐私保证
translated_abstract: 本文研究了通过随机梯度朗之万动力学训练的深度非参数回归，SGLD是随机梯度下降的一种变体，它在优化过程中注入经过精心校准的高斯噪声。利用针对深度ReLU网络量身定制的PAC-贝叶斯分析，我们建立了一个超额风险界，该风险界同时考虑了网络逼近误差、统计复杂度以及沿SGLD轨迹累积的算法代价。在Bernstein条件以及稳定的SGLD运行区域内，该超额风险界包含一个随机项，其系数与注入噪声的方差成反比，同时该估计量在Hölder光滑性条件下仍保持非参数回归的最优速率（最多相差对数因子）。这一结果为人们广泛观察到的适度SGLD噪声所带来的泛化益处提供了一个兼顾逼近误差、速率最优的统计视角。
tldr: 该论文利用针对深度ReLU网络的PAC-贝叶斯分析，为通过SGLD训练的深度M回归建立了同时刻画网络逼近误差、统计复杂度和算法累积代价的超额风险界，证明注入适度高斯噪声的估计量在Hölder光滑条件下达到最优非参数回归速率，并为SGLD噪声带来的泛化益处及隐私保证提供了理论解释。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes a PAC-Bayesian excess-risk bound for deep M-regression trained via SGLD that jointly accounts for network approximation error, statistical complexity, and algorithmic cost along the SGLD trajectory, proving the noise-injected estimator achieves optimal nonparametric regression rates under Hölder smoothness and providing a statistical and privacy perspective on the generalization benefits of moderate SGLD noise.
